messages.subject: knitr::spin() guide: few more things to be done
parts:
I've made this page as a brief guide for knitr::spin()
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/3180464/miknitr-spin.html

and would like to contribute it.

I run my R scripts for spin() as follows:

require(knitr) 
spin("miknitr-spin.R") 
knit2html('miknitr-spin.Rmd', options = c('toc', markdown::markdownHTMLOptions(TRUE)),stylesheet="/media/alobo/Iomega_HDD/Rutils/custom.css")

is there a simpler way (besides making an ad-hoc R function)?

Also
* Can the TOC be located after the title and with "Table of Contents" as a Heading?
* Can lines of R comment be wider? (options(width=180) seems to apply to output only)
* Can chunks of R code be never executed (i.e., for the 3 commands above)?

I'd appreciate help with these questions.
Also, please point to me any error you might find in the html

Thanks
